content.title: Update webapp-spec.md and webapp-roadmap.md port references
content.description:
Per library-architect's accepted review (comment mqibd3i1rm on mqiax8p1ib), refresh stale port references in the specs/roadmap you own. Source of truth = implemented values from closed task mqh2hwulrt (dev API 3001, dev Vite 3000, E2E API 5001, E2E Vite 5000).

Edits (exact):
1. .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md line 724: 'const port = process.env.PORT || 3000;' -> default 3001.
2. .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md line 762: env table row '| PORT | 3000 | Server port |' -> 3001.
3. .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md line 768 prose: 'Vite 5173 proxying to Hono 3000' -> 'Vite 3000 proxying the api route to Hono 3001'.
4. .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md line 775 area: proxy target localhost 3000 -> 3001, and update the embedded vite.config.ts snippet to set server.port 3000 reusing apiPort 3001.
5. .agentic/specs/webapp-roadmap.md line 35: proxy target localhost 3000 -> 3001.

Acceptance criteria: after the change, the only ports mentioned in those two files are dev API 3001, dev Vite 3000, E2E API 5001, E2E Vite 5000 (no remaining 5173/5174/3000-as-API).

content.content:
Done. Updated port references in the two spec docs to match the implemented dev layout (issue mqh2hwulrt).

webapp-spec.md:
- L724: PORT default 3000 to 3001
- L762: env table PORT row 3000 to 3001
- L768 prose: rewrote to 'Vite 3000 proxying the api route to Hono 3001'
- L770-779: updated the embedded vite.config.ts snippet to set server.port 3000 (via VITE_PORT) and reuse apiPort 3001 in the proxy target

webapp-roadmap.md:
- L35: Vite proxy target localhost 3000 to 3001

Verified with a grep sweep: no remaining 5173/5174/localhost-3000/3000-as-API references in either file. E2E ports (5001/5000) are not mentioned in these two docs, so nothing to add there. Sister issue mqibz5my2g covers the webapp-validator expertise copy.
